sentences.text: The Corruption and Crime Commission conducted a final review of two outstanding recommendations about controlled medicines in WA Health.
sentences.support: Two recommendations were left open to allow for the implementation of DoH's over-arching medicines handling policy.

sentences.text: The recommendations sought procedures aligned with legislation and consistent rules for drug management, records and reporting of discrepancies.
sentences.support: WA Health's Operational Directives and hospital policies be reviewed to ensure that policies for drug management, recording and reporting discrepancies are consistent across WA Health.

sentences.text: The Commission concluded that the medicines policy framework addressed earlier inconsistencies and that WA Health had adequately responded to the remaining recommendations.
sentences.support: These changes address the highlighted areas of inconsistency from previous Commission reports.

sentences.text: The Commission closed all recommendations while recognising that controlled drugs would continue to present misconduct risks.
sentences.support: the Commission acknowledges that management of controlled drugs will remain an area of continued misconduct risk for WA Health to mitigate.

findings.quote: The Commission considers WA Health has taken adequate action to address the remaining two recommendations.
The Commission considers all recommendations closed.
